chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 282: Han Li's Half-Year Pact with Xin Ruyin – Ancient Array Repair
chapter_meta_description: Han Li negotiates a half-year pact with Xin Ruyin and Qi Yunxiao to repair an ancient teleportation array. A masterclass in Mortal Stream social tribulation.
og_title: Han Li vs. The Social Tribulation: Chapter 282
og_description: Half a year, one ancient array, and a couple who won't move. Han Li masters the art of the risky favor.
twitter_description: Han Li seals a half-year deal with Xin Ruyin to fix an ancient teleportation array. But the real battle is the conversation—a masterclass in Mortal Stream risk.

lore_anchors.definition: A prehistoric, long-distance travel formation; a fragmented remnant of a fallen civilization. Knowledge to repair such arrays is largely lost, making any functional knowledge extremely rare.
